environment.description: Bare-metal deployment running the Terraform provider API directly on port 8080. PostgreSQL 14 backend with direct connections (no pooler). The service runs as root with full access to environment variables including cloud credentials (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, VAULT_TOKEN, etc). No reverse proxy or request filtering. Docker host network mode with --privileged flag.

config.env_vars: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, VAULT_TOKEN, DATABASE_URL with superuser credentials
